name: Syncthing
description: Synchronize files directly between trusted devices using a constrained manual TCP profile.
limitations: This KITPro profile supports manually addressed peers over TCP only; global discovery, local discovery, relays, NAT traversal, and QUIC are disabled.
The administration interface is loopback-only by default and initially has no Syncthing GUI password.
KITPro does not automate device pairing, peer addresses, folder creation, firewall changes, or router configuration.
One administrator-registered read-write storage root is required and is mounted at /sync.
Application backup includes Syncthing configuration and device identity but excludes files stored in the external sync root.
Changing the constrained network settings inside Syncthing is outside this experimental KITPro profile.
